questions.question: What is Cursed Spirit Manipulation?
questions.subject: Cursed Spirit Manipulation

answer.item: As the name suggests, Cursed Spirit Manipulation is a technique where one can completely control cursed spirits they were able to conquer in battle.

questions.question: How does the user gain dominance over an absorbed curse?
questions.subject: Cursed Spirit Manipulation

answer.item: Orally consuming this orb of the curse's remains gives the user complete dominance over the vagabond curse, allowing them to summon them at any time in the future.

questions.question: When can a curse manipulator absorb a spirit with no conditions?
questions.subject: Cursed Spirit Manipulation

answer.item: If the difference in grade is two levels or more, the curse manipulator can absorb a cursed spirit with practically no conditions attached.

questions.question: What does the Maximum: Uzumaki technique do?
questions.subject: Cursed Spirit Manipulation

answer.item: Uzumaki 極ノ番「うずまき」 Gokunoban・Uzumaki combines any number of cursed spirits in the user's possession into one and hits the target with a blast of supercondensed cursed energy.
